## Change

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Trust boundary

State which security invariant, schema, decision rule, or compatibility surface is affected. Write `none` when none is affected.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] Positive behavior is tested
- [ ] Adversarial behavior is tested when applicable
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, personal data, or proprietary fixtures are included
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when applicable
